serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry
Ecclesiasticalot FF: {{punch}}Your God!
W-What’s going on! The whole ground started to shake!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You abandoned your God! You stopped coming to Masses; you stopped praying… {{wi}}His Son died for your sins, and that’s how you pay him?!
You: I no longer believe that crap! 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yet, you still tremble at the mention of his name. These tremors aren’t my doing; they're yours. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You don’t believe now, but at some point you did, right? And that part of you is terrified. 
You: Of what? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: {{punch}}ETERNAL DAMNATION! 
You: {{punch}}Wha-!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You buried these doubts deep inside you; like a coward, you decided to stop thinking about it, but your sins keep piling up, and it’s eating you alive!
You: None of that is real! I stopped thinking about it because it’s stupid!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Then why do you fear?! Why is it tormenting you?!
You: It’s just existential dread! Nothing more! Everyone has it!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Excuses, excuses.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I said my piece. Now it’s time to duel. {{wi}}We will see if you really have abandoned your faith.
